messages:
eli: Flagging Opal (int4) canary: multi-tool responses sometimes reorder array fields in tool args -> schema rejects downstream. sample window 3k reqs, array-order parse_fail 0.4% -> 2.9% after int4 roll.
sasha: can you paste a couple of raw outputs? curious if it's consistent (always same array order) or random.
eli: examples: ```
{"tool":"merge_results","args":{"items":[{"id":1,"tags":["a","b"]},{"id":2,"tags":["c","d"]}]}}

{"tool":"merge_results","args":{"items":[{"id":1,"tags":["b","a"]},{"id":2,"tags":["d","c"]}]}}
```
ben: whoa that's a tag-order inversion inside nested arrays. could be tokenizer->detokenizer jitter or a streaming boundary causing element swap.
priya: run structured-eval on golden multi-tool set (5k) comparing opal-int8 vs opal-int4 and measure array-order flips + schema-strict pass. I'll queue it.
ravi: any kvcache or batching differences for opal-int4? previous swaps correlated with aggressive KV reuse across threads.
ben: repro command: `./repro --model opal --quant int4 --route /agent/merge_results --n 2500 --dump-tokens --kvcache on`
canary-bot: ALERT: Opal-int4 cohort breach: array_order_fail_rate 2.9% > thresh 1.5%. Incident INC-2026-210 created.
ben: quick repro done: int8 array_flip 0.3%, int4 2.8%. int4 + kvcache_off -> 0.5%. token dumps show near-boundary token IDs differ for list separators. sending dump to infra.
sasha: good signal. short-term: disable kvcache for opal-int4 cohort and add a lightweight postprocess that enforces input-specified ordering when we can (if args include an explicit order key). mark outputs with `heuristic_reordered_fix`.
priya: agree but be careful: enforcing order may hide semantic regressions for users who rely on model-generated ordering. label and measure semantics delta via embedding similarity on fixed items.
eli: pausing opal-int4 rollout. tasks: ben -> disable kvcache and push postprocess flag; ravi -> open kernel triage ONB-1102 with token dumps; sasha -> run structured-eval and produce schema-strict diff.
ben: applying kvcache off to cohort B and pushing small postprocess. adding metric `array_order_healed_count`.
canary-bot: NOTE: kvcache disabled for opal-int4 cohort at 2860011248. Monitoring.
priya: once structured-eval finishes I'll draft a regression blurb for release notes and recommended mitigations.
eli: thanks team  we'll review in stand tomorrow.
